title: Morning rush in Vienna: every U-Bahn train, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in Vienna, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every U-Bahn train inside the city on an average October weekday. The feed has no S-Bahn trains, so they are not shown.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside the Vienna city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: U1, U2, U3, U4 and U6.

Busiest moment of the morning: 110 U-Bahn trains at 7:27 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable and leaves out National Day (October 26). Wiener Linien changed its timetables during October, so its weekday uses one typical date.
